sources.title: CleanRL (Clean Implementation of RL Algorithms) - GitHub
sources.snippet: CleanRL is a Deep Reinforcement Learning library that provides high-quality single-file implementation with research-friendly features. The implementation is clean and simple, yet we can scale it to run thousands of experiments using AWS Batch.
